title: Red Hat Security Advisory: sos security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-79655) exists in the sos package used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. This flaw occurs during tar extraction in the sos clean process due to unvalidated symlink and hardlink targets, allowing arbitrary file writes. Red Hat has released an update that fixes this issue in sos version 4.11.2-7.el9_9. The vulnerability is rated as important by Red Hat Product Security.
